property_summary: For any role bytes32 and any account, calling renounceRole(role, account) (by that account) must leave hasRole(role, account) false forever; the mutant grants the role instead, so hasRole becomes true for previously-unheld roles, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Replace `_revokeRole` with `_grantRole` so calling renounceRole grants the role instead of revoking it.
